```sql
WITH cafe_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    'POINT (-111.923575 33.62488)'::geography AS geometry,
    'Press Coffee' AS poi_name
),
region_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    geometry
  FROM 
    regions
  WHERE 
    region_name ILIKE 'Scottsdale' AND 
    border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, region_geom.geometry::geometry, true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, region_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, region_geom.geometry::geometry)
),
regional_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Stats(clipped_rast, 1, true) AS stats
  FROM 
    dem_clip
),
cafe_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(rast, cafe_geom.geometry::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, cafe_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, cafe_geom.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  cafe_elevation.elevation,
  regional_stats.stats.mean,
  cafe_geom.poi_name
FROM 
  cafe_elevation, regional_stats, cafe_geom
WHERE 
  cafe_elevation.elevation > regional_stats.stats.mean;
```
